name: ANSI/IEEE Audible bell form
summary: IEEE-library form of audible bell: a bell indication identifies an audible annunciation output in a control circuit.
description: This reference locates audible bell in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous family. A bell indication identifies an audible annunciation output in a control circuit. The public library uses HAN1B for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.
